description: This file defines a PasswordHasher class implementing password hashing using HMACSHA512, part of the security infrastructure in the project.

classes.name: PasswordHasher
classes.description: A class responsible for hashing passwords using HMACSHA512 with a fixed key, implementing the IPasswordHasher interface.

methods.name: Hash
methods.description: Asynchronously computes a hash of the provided password concatenated with salt using HMACSHA512.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes the HMACSHA512 instance to free resources.
